item.title: Join Our Teams
item.description: The Journal of Humanities, Social Sciences and Research (JHSSR) cordially invites self-motivated and experienced scholars from around the world to become valued members of its Editorial/Reviewer Teams. As JHSSR adheres to a rigorous double-blind peer review policy, we seek committed academicians and researchers who possess the professional integrity, analytical expertise, and sufficient time to critically evaluate and edit scholarly manuscripts with diligence and impartiality.
